interpretation: Source-declared versions; opaque image contents were not resolved. Upstream fixes are not new pipeline findings without reproductions.

fixes.description: The stats command now excludes secondary/supplementary duplicate records from duplicate counts and excludes unknown zero insert sizes consistently from insert-size statistics.
fixes.relevance: The pipeline uses samtools stats before and after filtering/deduplication. Its QC summaries can encounter the relevant record flags or TLEN=0. Actual output impact has not been reproduced; no claim that flagstat, scaling, peaks or counts change from this fix.

fixes.description: Additional fixes harden record/tag parsing, reference caches, CRAM errors and optional commands.
fixes.relevance: Separate robustness/format-trigger review; the listed markdup/checksum/mpileup options are not the default Picard duplicate-marking path.

tools.coverage_limit: Release-note scan of saved 1.20-and-newer records; not an exhaustive audit of every bundled executable or binary build. A pre-existing defect is not automatically a regression introduced by 448.

fixes.description: Fixes include native-S3 reads at a part-boundary EOF, index/record validation, expression-filter parsing, compressed-reference index rebuild failures and CRAM handling.
fixes.relevance: BAM/index robustness can be relevant to used libraries. Native-S3 and compressed-FASTA/CRAM triggers are not established for this Fusion-backed, plain-FASTA/BAM campaign. Library security fixes do not by themselves demonstrate numerical differences on these valid inputs.

tools.coverage_limit: The environment pin does not prove which HTSlib was linked into every executable/container; actual package manifests were not inspected.

fixes.description: 3.12 repairs recursive searches of directories with at least 100,000 entries and an interaction between a match limit and /dev/null output.
fixes.relevance: The inspected UNTAR wrapper uses grep -o -P over an archive listing, not recursive directory search or the affected match-limit form. No matching trigger identified in those module commands.

tools.coverage_limit: Official release NEWS was read from the release archive; arbitrary user scripts and complete transitive dependency behaviour are outside scope.

fixes.description: 4.9 repairs in-place symlink cycles, very large command/input lines, specific Unicode matching and temporary-file error handling.
fixes.relevance: The inspected extraction wrappers use simple ASCII version-string substitutions in pipes. The documented triggers were not identified there.

tools.coverage_limit: Release NEWS and relevant wrapper commands were checked; no universal no-bug claim.

tools.relevance: Default-branch head and the v2.8 tag are identical. No later merged default-branch correction exists in that comparison.
tools.coverage_limit: Unmerged branches, external libraries and build-specific differences were not audited.

fixes.relevance: The ATAC workflow supplies sorted uncompressed bedGraph, so the compressed-input trigger is bypassed in the inspected path.
